app.title: Cesto
app.disclaimer: Uses an unofficial MCP, not affiliated with Continente. Never checks out or pays.
status.title: Status
status.session_expired: Expired: sign in on the Continente MCP add-on
status.test_mode_on: Test mode on: changes are only simulated, the real cart is not touched.
status.test_mode_off: Real cart: the add-on adds, changes and removes items in your Continente cart. It can never check out, pay or place an order.
tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.name: Name
tokens.copy_now: Copy this token now; it is not shown again:
export.title: Export data
export.help: Downloads lists, history and preferences as JSON (no tokens or credentials).
error.invalid_token_request: Enter a name (up to 60 characters) and a type.
ha.session_expired.title: Continente session expired
ha.session_expired.message: The Continente session expired. Lists wait until you sign in again on the [Continente MCP add-on]({url}).
error.remote_forbidden: Not available away from home: only the shopping list can be used through Home Assistant.
error.ai_failed: The AI provider failed; showing Continente promotions found by search.
error.admin_only: Only Home Assistant administrators can open this page.
connectors.title: Supermarkets
connectors.help: Supermarkets enabled in the add-on options. The app hides features a supermarket does not support.
pair.title: Connect a phone
pair.help: Creates a token for this device only and shows a QR code to scan in the Cesto app. The token is shown once and can be revoked below.
pair.scan: Scan this code in the Cesto app (Connect to server → Scan QR code). Do not share it.
import.title: Import data
import.help: Imports an exported file (including from the old Continente MCP add-on). Only works while Cesto is empty. Credentials and tokens are not imported.
error.invalid_address: Invalid address. Use for example http://homeassistant.local:8099.
error.import_format: This file is not a Cesto export.
error.import_not_empty: Cesto already has data; import only works while the add-on is empty.
error.capability_unsupported: This supermarket does not support this feature.
continente.title: Continente
continente.help: The Continente account, session and sign-in live in the Continente MCP add-on. Cesto uses it with its own token.
continente.unavailable: Unavailable: install or start the Continente MCP add-on
continente.approve_help: Open the Continente MCP page and approve the "Cesto" request with this fingerprint.
error.moved_to_continente_mcp: This moved to the Continente MCP add-on.
error.continente_unavailable: The Continente MCP add-on is not available.
